t: You're standing on Fitzneal Street, in the London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham. The street is named after Richard FitzNeal, a churchman and bureaucrat who served Henry II. He was Lord High Treasurer of the Exchequer from 1156 to 1196, and he wrote the Dialogus de Scaccario, the first administrative treatise of the Middle Ages. From 1189 until his death in 1198 he was also Bishop of London.
